title: 第一卷 第342章 小师妹你的腿现在能站稳吗第一卷 第341章 情敌见面分外眼红
slug: 笨蛋美人当团宠师兄们抢疯了
content_zh:
舒晩昭还不知道龙的具体实力，只知道对方比百年强大很多，结果一听谢寒声的修为，在心里默默竖起大拇指，小古板牛逼啊，竟然快渡劫期了？
要知道师尊也才渡劫后期的修为。
师尊拥有鲛人的血脉，修炼到渡劫期也用了几百年，而谢寒声只用了一百年就归墟了，归墟距离渡劫是一个大门槛，可是以谢寒声的能力，再过几百年，也会和师尊一样。
怪不得是传说中的男主呢。
舒晩昭偷瞄沈长安，“那师兄？”
这可是另外一个男主。
沈长安含笑：“归墟初期。”
“哇~”舒姥姥发出惊叹的声音，星星眼，满脸崇拜，“大师兄真厉害。”
小丫头，越来越会捧哏了，沈长安笑了笑，“我们小师妹也很厉害，现在已经成为家喻户晓的小魔女了，外面现在止小儿夜啼，都是说‘再哭丢进龙族秘境让女魔头把你吃了’，师妹也很棒。”
舒晩昭：“……”
总感觉这句话好像不是夸人的，她转念一想自己恶毒女配的人设，能止小儿夜啼已经很成功了。
她挠挠头，还是很纠结，“可是二师兄他想要打一条龙还是很费力的。”
“他能逃。”
舒晩昭忧心忡忡，“可是二师兄驴脾气……唔。”
不等舒晩昭说完，就被大师兄捏住了小嘴巴，手动闭麦，他道：“师妹，时隔百年，第一次见面，我不想经常从你嘴里听到其他男人的名字。”
舒晩昭的眼睛一下子就瞪圆了。
大师兄被什么东西附身了不成，竟然说出这种话。
这么霸道，说好的谦谦君子呢？
【啧，臭男人原形毕露。】
舒晩昭：“……”

舒晩昭终于老实了，沈长安松开了对她的钳制，他见她惊如小鸟的表情，叹口气。
俯身过去，低头在她的额头轻轻吻了吻，喃喃细语：“师妹，师兄想你了。”
舒晩昭的呆毛一下子就竖了起来，被他从容地压下，温柔地轻吻如风拂过，舒晩昭下意识就闭上了眼睛，感知那股柔风一路向下。
从她的眉心，来到她如画的眉眼，她的睫毛不断颤抖。
沈长安微微一顿，用手摩挲着她的后颈以示安抚，在他温柔的动作下，警惕的小兽果然放下了防备，睫毛的抖动频率也降了下来。
他吻过去，捕抓到她不安分的睫毛，成功将她的眼睛封印。
舒晩昭的睫毛不抖了，手又开始哆嗦，颤巍巍伸出爪子勾住他衣服，就像是小猫崽子用肉垫拍了拍，煞是可爱。
沈长安眼底闪过一抹笑意，从她眼皮上挪开，路过她挺翘的鼻尖，再往下。
含住那朝思暮想的唇瓣。
他的吻和其他男人略有不同，就像是长者，牵引着无知的后辈，一步一步地攻陷她，再引诱她沉迷其中，他善于编织蛛网，无声无息将猎物困在其中，再一点点吞噬。
每一次，在舒晩昭呼吸不畅的时候，他都会稍微推开片刻，给她呼吸，呼吸两口之后，再次缠上去，温柔缱眷。
那一刻，舒晩昭终于知道什么叫做温柔乡英雄冢了。
像她这种英雌，也差点溺死在温柔乡中。
content_en:
Shu Mingzhao didn't know the specific strength of Long yet. He only knew that the other party was much stronger than a hundred years ago. When he heard Xie Hansheng's cultivation level, he silently gave a thumbs up in his heart. What an awesome little old-fashioned guy! He was about to pass the tribulation period?
You must know that Master is only at the later stage of the Tribulation.
The master has the bloodline of a shark, and it took hundreds of years to reach the stage of transcending the tribulation. However, it only took Xie Hansheng a hundred years to return to the ruins. Returning to the ruins is a big threshold before transcending the tribulation, but with Xie Hansheng's ability, in a few hundred years, he will be like his master.
No wonder he is the legendary male protagonist.
Shu Mingzhao glanced at Shen Changan secretly, "What about senior brother?"
This is another male protagonist.
Shen Changan smiled: "The early days of returning to the ruins."
"Wow~" Grandma Shu exclaimed with starry eyes and admiration on her face, "Elder brother is really amazing."
The little girl is becoming more and more adept at complimenting her. Shen Changan smiled and said, "Our junior sister is also very powerful. Now she has become a well-known little witch. Children outside are crying at night, and they all say, 'If you cry again, throw you into the secret realm of the dragon clan and let the female devil eat you.' Our junior sister is also great."
Shu Mingzhao: "..."
She always felt that this sentence was not a compliment. She then thought about her vicious female supporting character, and she was very successful in stopping children from crying at night.
She scratched her head, still confused, "But Second Senior Brother, it's still very difficult for him to fight a dragon."
"He can escape."
Shu Mingzhao was worried, "But the second senior brother has a donkey temper... ugh."
Before Shu Mingzhao could finish speaking, his senior brother pinched his small mouth and turned off the microphone manually. He said: "Junior sister, this is the first time we meet after a hundred years. I don't want to hear other men's names from your mouth often."
Shu Mingzhao's eyes suddenly widened.
The senior brother was possessed by something, so he actually said such words.
So domineering, where is the humble gentleman you promised to be?
[Tsk, the stinky man’s true colors are revealed. 】
Shu Mingzhao: "..."
Shu Mingzhao finally became honest, and Shen Changan released his grip on her. He sighed when he saw her frightened expression.
He leaned over, lowered his head and kissed her forehead gently, murmuring: "Junior sister, senior brother misses you."
Shu Mingzhao's hair suddenly stood up, and he pressed it down calmly, kissing her softly like the wind. Shu Mingzhao subconsciously closed his eyes, feeling the soft wind all the way down.
From the center of her eyebrows to her picturesque eyebrows, her eyelashes kept trembling.
Shen Changan paused slightly and rubbed the back of her neck with his hand to comfort her. Under his gentle movements, the vigilant little beast really dropped its guard, and the frequency of the trembling of its eyelashes also dropped.
He kissed her, caught her restless eyelashes, and successfully sealed her eyes.
Shu Zhaozhao's eyelashes stopped trembling, and his hands began to tremble again. He stretched out his trembling paws to hook his clothes, like a kitten patting him with its pads. It was really cute.
A smile flashed in Shen Changan's eyes, and he moved away from her eyelids, passing by the tip of her straight nose, and then down.
Hold those longing lips.
His kisses were slightly different from those of other men. He was like an elder, leading the ignorant younger generation, conquering her step by step, and then tempting her to indulge in it. He was good at weaving spider webs, trapping his prey in it silently, and then devouring it bit by bit.
Every time, when Shu Minzhao couldn't breathe smoothly, he would push her away for a moment and let her breathe. After taking two breaths, he would wrap her around again, tenderly and caringly.
At that moment, Shu Mingzhao finally knew what the Tomb of Heroes of Wenwen Township was.
A heroic woman like her almost drowned in the gentle land.
